prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1395; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through a major intersection in Pasadena, Texas, heading east. The light had been green for me as I approached.

Q: What was the traffic signal showing when you entered the intersection?

A: Green. I'm sure of it. I had my foot off the gas a little because I could see cross traffic starting to move, but I still had the right of way.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not really. It came from my right side, and by the time I noticed it, it was already on top of me. I braked, but there wasn't time to avoid it.

Q: Where did your vehicle make contact with the other car?

A: On the passenger side, right behind the front door. The other car hit me almost square on the side.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: My right knee hit the dashboard and the door frame. It hurt right away, but I thought it was just a bruise at first. By that evening it was swollen and I could barely bend it.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next day, and they referred me for imaging. I've got a follow-up scheduled with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and I didn't cause this. I'd like the claim handled fairly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
